gloss: separation of smoking and non-smoking areas

definitions.gloss: separation of smoking and non-smoking areas
definitions.explanation: The practice of designating separate areas for smokers and non-smokers in restaurants, offices, and public spaces. A key concept in Japanese public health policy.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{分煙|ぶんえん}です。
examples.english: This restaurant has separate smoking and non-smoking areas.

examples.japanese: ⟦{職場|しょくば}→職場：04164_shokuba⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{分煙|ぶんえん}⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}んでいる→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
examples.english: Smoking area separation measures are advancing in the workplace.

examples.japanese: ⟦{以前|いぜん}→以前：01790_izen⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{分煙|ぶんえん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{主流|しゅりゅう}→主流：11407_shuryuu⟧だった⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{全面禁煙|ぜんめんきんえん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{施設|しせつ}→施設：02503_shisetsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: Separation of smoking areas used to be the norm, but recently more facilities have gone completely smoke-free.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{分|ぶん}→分：26216_bun⟧ (divide/separate) and {煙|えん} (smoke). Refers to the policy of physically separating smoking and non-smoking areas rather than banning smoking entirely.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {分煙|ぶんえん}⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧: smoking separation measures
- {分煙|ぶんえん}⟦スペース→スペース：11049_supeesu⟧: separated smoking space
- ⟦{完全|かんぜん}→完全：01552_kanzen⟧{分煙|ぶんえん}: complete separation of smoking areas
- {分煙|ぶんえん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}む→進む：01225_susumu⟧: smoking separation progresses

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{禁煙|きんえん}→禁煙：02644_kinen⟧: no smoking / quitting smoking
- ⟦{喫煙|きつえん}→喫煙：17580_kitsuen⟧: smoking
- {全面禁煙|ぜんめんきんえん}: complete smoking ban
- {受動喫煙|じゅどうきつえん}: passive smoking / secondhand smoke

CULTURAL NOTE:
Japan has gradually tightened smoking regulations. The 2020 {改正健康増進法|かいせいけんこうぞうしんほう} (Revised Health Promotion Act) significantly expanded indoor smoking bans, making {分煙|ぶんえん} less common as many establishments shifted to {全面禁煙|ぜんめんきんえん}.
